6910.title: Android private-CA connection investigation
6910.rootCauseOneLine: Suspected native CA trust-store mismatch; source delegates to platform fetch, but Android runtime behavior is unverified.
6910.proposedFix: First reproduce on a clean Android release build with an installed throwaway CA, then decide global user-root versus scoped per-server trust and verify native fetch and WebView without disabling validation.
6910.caveats: No Android runtime or APK available. Two clean checkouts passed the real-TLS Node probe diagnostic and five existing tests; this is not an Android reproduction. Security-boundary changes are ineligible for the simple-fix path.
